text.text_excerpt: I came back again on a Tuesday evening with a friend and we sat at the bar. The food was delicious (I forgot to take pictures it was so good). Even thought the restaurant was busy for a Tuesday evening, I found myself able to have a conversation with my friend and actually hear her! The wine choices were decent, but I'd probably opt for a cocktail next time since those looked so delicious. The mussels are so good and so is their cheese plate! Would highly recommend both. They run a great happy hour as well, and it goes until 7pm! There's also outdoor seating for those nice days when you don't want to be limited to sitting indoors.

Have been many times for brunch (outstanding), happy hour (one of the best in town) and dinner. Last night I went for the Coolinary dinner and it was a great value and totally delicious. I had the salami and cantaloupe as my first course. The "salami" was actually more like a salami rillette - not a slice of salami but something you eat with a fork. It was spicy and paired nicely with the fresh cantaloupe. For the second course I had the ribeye. It was flavorful and a generous cut as well. I chose the Nutella dessert because I can never pass up Nutella. It was just the right size, not too big, with 2 blackberries on top. I've been to Bar Frances quite a few times since they opened. I've had dinner twice and brunch once and then just drinks... I was actually surprised the first time I came in (opening night!) to see they had a full dinner menu. From the pre-opening information, I thought this was going to be a wine bar with a small selection of snacks. NOPE. Full restaurant. So I sat at the bar and ate...everything that first night and it was delicious! And it's remained delicious each time I've been back. LOVE the mushroom toast. Love.
